text: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局：7月份，食品烟酒及在外餐饮类价格同比下降0.8%，影响CPI（居民消费价格指数）下降约0.22个百分点。食品中，畜肉类价格下降6.0%，影响CPI下降约0.25个百分点，其中猪肉价格下降13.3%；奶类价格下降1.5%，影响CPI下降约0.02个百分点；鲜果价格下降1.1%，影响CPI下降约0.02个百分点；蛋类价格上涨14.4%，影响CPI上涨约0.07个百分点。其他七大类价格同比六涨一降。其中，其他用品及服务、医疗保健价格分别上涨5.8%和2.9%，衣着、教育文化娱乐价格分别上涨1.4%和1.3%，生活用品及服务、交通
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 9 - NBS: In July, prices for food, tobacco, alcohol, and dining-out fell 0.8% year-on-year, contributing about 0.22 percentage points to the decline in the CPI. Among food, meat prices fell 6.0%, contributing about 0.25 percentage points to the CPI decline, with pork prices down 13.3%; dairy prices fell 1.5%, contributing about 0.02 percentage points to the CPI decline; fresh fruit prices fell 1.1%, contributing about 0.02 percentage points to the CPI decline; egg prices rose 14.4%, contributing about 0.07 percentage points to the CPI increase. Among the other seven major categories, six rose and one fell year-on-year. Among them, other goods and services, and medical care and health prices rose 5.8% and 2.9% respectively; clothing, and education, culture and entertainment rose 1.4% and 1.3% respectively; household goods and services, and transportation...
